description: This file defines interfaces and external variables for managing sparse indexing in a version control system, including functions for converting indices, expanding paths, and configuring sparse index settings.

methods.name: is_sparse_index_allowed
methods.description: Checks if sparse index is permitted given the current index state and flags.

methods.name: convert_to_sparse
methods.description: Converts a full index into a sparse index based on current state and flags.

methods.name: ensure_full_index
methods.description: Expands the current index to a full index, ensuring all entries are present.

methods.name: expand_to_path
methods.description: Expands a specified path within the index to a full range of cache entries, handling sparse directories.

methods.name: set_sparse_index_config
methods.description: Configures the repository to enable or disable sparse index features.

methods.name: expand_index
methods.description: Adjusts the index based on pattern list to include relevant file entries, expanding sparse directories as needed.

methods.name: ensure_correct_sparsity
methods.description: Ensures the index maintains correct sparsity settings.

methods.name: clear_skip_worktree_from_present_files
methods.description: Clears skip-worktree flags from present files in the index.
